spec.name: starter-fork-join
spec.description: Plan, fan out, reduce, verify, synthesize, approve - the fork/join shape with a verifier and a gate.
spec.goal: A short answer built only from findings that survived an adversarial check.

nodes.description: Split the task into three independent angles.
nodes.prompt:
Task: {{ input.task }}
Split it into exactly 3 sub-questions that can be researched independently (different angles, no overlap).

nodes.description: One worker per sub-question, in parallel, each in its own context.
nodes.prompt:
Sub-question "{{ item.name }}": {{ item.question }}
You have no tools. Answer from reasoning and well-known practice, not from invented sources.
Give 2-4 findings. Each finding has one specific claim, the reasoning behind it (say "reasoning:" when it is not
a cited fact), and an honest confidence between 0 and 1. Use confidence 0.5 or lower for claims you cannot check.

nodes.description: Adversarial check of each finding; killed findings never reach the answer.
nodes.prompt:
Finding: {{ json item }}
The workers had no tools. A finding based on reasoning is acceptable when it says so.
Kill the finding only for these reasons: the claim contradicts its own evidence, the claim is too vague to act on,
the numbers do not add up, or the confidence is above 0.6 for a claim that is not checkable.
Otherwise pass it. List any weaker problems as reasons but still pass.

nodes.description: Synthesis from surviving findings only, with visible coverage.
nodes.prompt:
Answer the task using ONLY the findings in <input>. Cite each finding you use by its claim text in `used_claims`.
State what remains uncertain. Mention how many workers completed and the share of findings the verifier killed.

nodes.title: Record this answer?
nodes.prompt: Read the answer. Then approve or reject.
nodes.approve_effect: The system records the answer (placeholder side effect).
nodes.reject_effect: The system records nothing. The run stops.

checklist.item: Every edge carries real data or authority
Every node has one bounded job with structured output
Independent nodes can run in parallel
Joins are placed only where the full set is required
Important results are verified before moving downstream
Failures can be retried without duplicating side effects
The graph can resume from a checkpoint
checklist.note: Strands session state + gren checkpoints after every node

checklist.item: Every cycle has a hard stop and budget
A human can interrupt high-risk paths

checklist.note: router decisions are logged with the state that produced them

hints: Reducers removed <10% of records: synthesis is reading almost raw fan-out output. Consider stronger dedupe/ranking.
Peak width hit the budget (3/3). Raising it only helps if workers add unique coverage.
